editionLabel: Days of Wonder English rules, 2015 file
firstPlayerRule: Start with whoever saw a relic most recently, then take turns clockwise.
officialTieBreak: If nobody in the group has ever seen a relic, the rules instead use the most recent visit to a shrine or temple.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Choose the starting player before turning over the top tile of each purple temple.
